targets.title: What do they think and feel about growth? An expectancy-value approach to small business managers’ attitudes toward growth
targets.evidence_quote: We replicate the Wiklund et al. (2003) study examining the attitudes towards growth of small business managers.
targets.outcome_quote: The principal finding is that the strongest perceived consequence affecting attitudes towards growth among U.S.-based small business managers is the ability to increase income and other financial benefits. Change in employee well-being and change in dependence on outside stakeholders also ranked relatively high among eight potential growth consequences. The Wiklund et al. (2003) Swedish study finds, in contrast, that non-economic consequences are the strongest predictor of attitudes towards growth.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Abstract explicitly contrasts the central strongest growth-attitude predictor with the original; economic versus non-economic consequences. Full reference unavailable; only surname and deposited reference title are available.
